answer_1.quote: Conversational Recommender System (CRS) explores user preference through natural language dialogues... the generation module also interacts with the reasoning tree to extract relevant textual information.

answer_2.quote: For the response generation task, we evaluate models by Bleu-n(n=2,3) , Dist-n(n=3,4) for word-level matches and diversity... The results of PPL show that the extraction of the relevant information reduced the model confusion.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the generation performance more equitably, three annotators are invited to score the generated candidates from two datasets for human evaluation on the following three aspects: Fluency, Relevance, and Informativeness. The interannotator coherence is measured by Fleiss' Kappa.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored generated responses on Fluency, Relevance, and Informativeness.
